claims.head: Carolina should get plenty of shots away
claims.body: Few teams shoot as often as Carolina: 65.8 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5, 3rd in the league. Chicago sits 26th of 32 at keeping shots down.

claims.head: Chicago pounces on mistakes, and Carolina makes them
claims.body: Carolina gives up more dangerous chances after losing the puck than most (24th of 32 at avoiding breakdowns). Chicago ranks 9th for chances off turnovers.
